post.description: Assigns a task on a form to a user, optionally scheduling it and linking it to a location. If a task with the same code already exists, it is updated instead of creating a new one.

parameters.name: form_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the form the task will be assigned on.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Email or identifier of the user the task is assigned to. If it does not match an existing user, the task may fall back to another user of the account, so use a valid, existing identifier.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code that identifies the task assignment. If a task with this code already exists, it is updated instead of created.

parameters.name: task_instruction
parameters.description: Instructions shown to the user for this task.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date and time the task is scheduled for. Defaults to the current date and time when omitted or invalid.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.description: Time window, in hours, around the scheduled date during which the task can be completed. Defaults to 4.

parameters.name: mandatory
parameters.description: Who the task is mandatory for. Defaults to for_everyone.

parameters.name: late_response_allowed
parameters.description: Indicates whether the task can still be completed after its scheduled window.

parameters.name: location_name
parameters.description: Name of the location linked to the task. A new location is created if it does not already exist.

parameters.name: location_address
parameters.description: Address of the location linked to the task.

parameters.name: l_code
parameters.description: Code used to find an existing location linked to the task.

parameters.name: l_phone
parameters.description: Phone number of the location linked to the task.

parameters.name: l_email
parameters.description: Email address of the location linked to the task.

parameters.name: c_name
parameters.description: Name of the company linked to the location.

parameters.name: c_code
parameters.description: Code of the company linked to the location.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the location linked to the task.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the location linked to the task.

200.description: Task assigned successfully, or an error reported in the response body.

result.description: Outcome of the request, for example ok or an error message.

task.description: The created or updated task assignment. Its exact set of fields is not fully documented here.

400.description: The task could not be assigned.

post.description: Changes the status of an existing form answer.

parameters.name: form_name
parameters.description: Name of the form the answer belongs to.

parameters.name: form_code
parameters.description: Code of the form answer to update.

parameters.name: form_state_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the status to set on the form answer.

status.description: Outcome of the request, for example ok.

form_answer.description: The updated form answer. Its exact set of fields is not fully documented here.

400.description: The status could not be changed, for example because the form, form answer, or status was not found.

post.description: Creates or updates a single question's answer on an existing form answer. The new answer is always stored as free text, regardless of the original question type.

parameters.name: form_name
parameters.description: Name or identifier of the form the answer belongs to.

parameters.name: form_code
parameters.description: Code of the form answer to update. The alias code is also accepted.

parameters.name: question_name
parameters.description: Name of the question to create or update.

parameters.name: question_value
parameters.description: New value to set for the question.

parameters.name: subform_index
parameters.description: Row number of a subform table to update. When omitted, the answer at the root of the form is updated. Behavior for values other than a positive row number is not fully documented here.

200.description: Form answer updated, or an error reported in the response body.

status.description: Outcome of the request: ok or error.

form_answer.description: The updated form answer. Its exact set of fields is not fully documented here.

400.description: The request could not be processed, for example because the form or token was missing.

post.description: Generates a new form answer and its PDF from an existing form template. Any parameter besides form_id, emails, token, and action is treated as an answer to the matching question in the form, so this action supports as many additional fields as the selected form defines questions for. Not all question types are fully supported, which may result in unexpected behavior. This action does not trigger GSheet Sync, Automatic Signature, or other webhooks such as Power Automate triggers.

parameters.name: form_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the form template used to generate the new answer.

parameters.name: emails
parameters.description: Email addresses that receive the generated PDF.

200.description: Form answer and PDF generated successfully. If no question values are provided besides form_id, emails, and token, the response behavior is not fully documented here.

form_answer_id.description: Identifier of the generated form answer.

400.description: The request could not be processed, for example because the account or form was not found.

post.description: Creates a new ticket. Tickets are not stored in the same database as forms and tasks, so some response fields below could not be fully verified against the underlying storage.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the ticket.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the ticket.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Ticket type. When set, it can fill in defaults such as priority, expiration, location, and assignees, which may override other values sent in the same request.

parameters.name: author_email
parameters.description: Email of the user registered as the author of the ticket. If it does not match an existing user, the ticket is created under the account associated with the token.

parameters.name: creation_date
parameters.description: Date and time the ticket was created.

parameters.name: expiration_date
parameters.description: Date and time the ticket expires.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the ticket.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Priority of the ticket.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the location linked to the ticket.

parameters.name: location_name
parameters.description: Name of the location linked to the ticket.

parameters.name: location_type
parameters.description: Type of the location linked to the ticket.

parameters.name: assignees
parameters.description: Users assigned to the ticket.

parameters.name: invitees
parameters.description: Users invited to the ticket.

finding.description: The created ticket. Its exact set of fields could not be fully verified against the underlying storage.

403.description: Ticket access is not available for this account, for example because the trial has not started or access has been closed.

422.description: The ticket could not be created.

error.description: Description of the reason the ticket could not be created.

delete.description: Unsubscribes a webhook. Called automatically by the platform when a flow is turned off, updated, or deleted. Required so the platform knows this operation exists: the subscribe responses above return this same path in the Location header, but without a matching delete operation declared here, the platform never calls it.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the account that owns the subscription.

parameters.name: webhook_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the webhook subscription.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Unique token that authorizes the deletion of this specific subscription.

400.description: The subscription could not be deleted.
